selection_rule: Earliest event date from CSV event/question, then filename lexicographic; no price, outcome, or volume selection. Inspection scope amended original gate to permit schema inspection despite missing CSV token/rules.

selection.event: Highest temperature in NYC on July 15?
selection.question: Will the highest temperature in New York City be between 108-109°F on July 15?

classification: Snapshot-bearing compact data, not merely trade proxy or snapshots.csv five-minute summary. Raw uncompressed exchange feed and precise executable book are NOT established.
findings: CSV has condition-to-filename binding, but CSV and Parquet contain no token IDs or token orientation.
Parquet has 3161 snapshots, 49 deltas, 11 trades. All 49 delta records share timestamps with 11 trade groups; original within-group ordering and compact-transform semantics are not established.
367 snapshot reseeds exist, but no sequence or connection ID; inter-record gaps are observed gaps, not proven feed outages.
CSV data_end is 2026-07-16T05:57:15Z; actual Parquet max t is 2026-07-16T05:58:51.762Z, a metadata discrepancy of 96.762 seconds.
The selected July15 event is covered around its July15 18:00Z decision. It does not cover July16 18:00Z. Do not shift its date to match directory name.
July18 14:00 coverage is not demonstrated; CSV contains no July18 event and README total span ends July18 05:19Z.
One snapshot has parsed levels but no verified full-depth reconstruction; fee, original rules, NOAA availability and labels remain missing.

nonduplication.scope: Existing dot C01 weather observation timing hypothesis only; no new claim, mechanism, or entry. known has no weather-named mechanism; this does not certify novelty against other claims.

audit_limitations: Initial CSV diagnostic preview and directory README response exposed outcome/volume values inadvertently; they were not used for selection, conclusions or PnL. First structural shape diagnostic printed a price level; final evidence suppresses levels/prices.
GitHub fetch returned INVALID_ARGUMENT UTF-8-only for binary; official fetch_file(base64) of same file succeeded, not denial bypass.
Initial pyarrow install to default home failed read-only; installation to permitted shared path succeeded.
Full known and own claims were locally read for identity/scope; no strategy outcomes used.
next_requirement: Obtain source-documented token orientation, timestamp provenance, compact delta transform/order, snapshot/reseed completeness and original rules through permitted public metadata before any replay. Requires expanded metadata-only scope if root README/license is to be read.
